h1: Smart product search that understands what shoppers mean
overview: Shoppers type things like warm jacket for hiking or a gift for mum, and plain keyword search shows nothing. We add a search that understands meaning, handles typos and synonyms and ranks products by how well they fit the request. It reads your product titles, descriptions and tags, shows instant results as people type and gives you a list of searches that found no match.

faq: Which store platforms does it work with?
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce and most custom stores. On Shopify we use compatible search apps and your theme where possible. Tell us your platform and we confirm the approach.
Do I have to pay for a search app?
Some search tools have a free plan and others charge monthly, billed by them to you. We suggest one that matches your catalog size and tell you the cost before we install anything.
Will it slow down my store?
We pick tools that load search results quickly and check page speed before and after. Search is added so it does not block the rest of the page from loading.
Can I control which products show first?
Yes. In the higher packages you can pin items or boost collections, for example new arrivals or items with stock. We show you how to change these rules.
